checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Welcoming gym rather than intimidating bodybuilding
must.why: Group of regular people exercising in a modern, warmly lit gym; not bodybuilding-focused.

must.item: Text reads exactly the four lines
must.why: No text appears in any frame.

must.item: All four text lines visible together during final 5 seconds
Details large, high-contrast, inside frame, no clipping
Vertical, ~10 s, upbeat music no voiceover
must.why: Vertical 480x854 and 10 s with audio present; music mood and absence of voice can't be verified.

faults.what: None of the required gym name, address or hours text appears anywhere in the video.
Motion blur and ghosting on the runner/rope in early frames, with a smeared, warped limb and body look.
Shirt logo on the athlete is a garbled AI-generated mark.
Clip is a plain gym montage with no end card; the 480p resolution is low.

summary: A vertical 10 s gym montage with decent visuals, but it has none of the required text (name, address, hours), so it fails the core requirement.
